nodes.question: What is the central goal of the 2030 Agenda as discussed in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The central goal of the 2030 Agenda is to achieve quality education for sustainability.
nodes.paragraph: These skills are foundational for personal and professional development in the twenty-first century and are inseparably linked to education S role in addressing global challenges in the Anthropocene era. While global initiatives like the United Nations Human Rights Declaration (Kunz, 1949) and the Open Education Movement have advanced the idea of education for all, challenges remain in achieving quality education for sustainability, a goal central to the 2030 Agenda (UNIGSSG, 2023). In the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic, rising pov - erty and inequality further highlight the need for more equitable policies and practices (Mudaly & Chirikure, 2023). In the context of Sustainable Development Goal 4, AI presents opportunities and challenges (Vinuesa et al., 2020). While it has the potential to support the aspirations of the 2030 Agenda, the impact of AI on achieving quality education is still underexplored. Digital technologies have provided solutions during the pandemic and have shown promise in improving education in the Global South, but the application of AI to overcome educational disparities is still in its early stages. nodes.question: What is a key objective of SSI teaching and learning highlighted in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: A key objective is to cultivate student competence and encourage them to become life-long learners who can solve common daily problems as well as future challenges.
nodes.paragraph: These PD programs can help teachers incorporate SSIs into their curricula by promoting collaborative design and reflective practices (Authors, 2022a; Friedrichsen et al., 2020; Kinskey & Zeidler, 2024; Leung, 2022). These studies highlighted the role of interac- tion and reflection in PD programs and focused on teachers beliefs, pedagogical content knowledge, attributes, or epistemic frames related to effective SSI teaching or qualitative lesson planning. The use of written surveys and semi-structured interviews in these studies ignored the progression of teachers epistemic frames during the PD program. Therefore, we examined changes in discourse and interaction in a PD program to elucidate teachers development for SSI teaching. Literature Review SSI Teaching and PD in Education Given the strong focus on cultivating student competence, SSI teaching and learning have received increasing attention in both classrooms and academia. For example, in Taiwan the Curriculum Guidelines of 12-year Basic Education merit attention to cultivating stu- dents core competencies and encouraging them to become life-long learners who can solve common daily problems as well as future challenges (Ministry of Education, 2021). Considering SSI as one of the daily and future challenges that students must overcome, the curriculum guidelines for natural science further emphasize infusing SSI into the curricu- lum through multiple methods such as inquiry-based learning and project-based learning (Ministry of Education, 2018).
